preview.headline: Battle for the Belt in Mobile: USA's run game against a Troy team that keeps giving the ball away.
preview.summary: Both teams are 4-5 and 2-3 in the Sun Belt, and both lost on Nov. 7. South Alabama has lost three straight by a combined 24 points; Troy has lost three of four and turned it over five times in a 41-17 home loss to Louisiana Tech.

matchup.why: The clearest gap on the page. Troy has scored 17 or fewer in five of nine games.
USA allows 408.4 yards a game (117th) and 6.9 a play; Troy allows 344.7 (52nd) and 5.4 a play.

matchup.metric: USA run game vs. Troy run defense
matchup.why: Strength against strength. USA ran for 159 at Louisiana, 54 below its average at the time.

matchup.metric: Troy run game vs. USA run defense
matchup.why: Louisiana ran for 312 against USA last week. Troy managed 47 on 32 carries against Louisiana Tech.
Troy went 3 of 15 on third down against Louisiana Tech. USA's defense has to get off the field when Troy is behind the sticks.
Troy lost four fumbles and threw an interception against Louisiana Tech, including a strip-sack returned for a TD.
Both teams were flagged 9 times last week (USA for 65 yards, Troy for 68).

usa: Stop the run. Louisiana ran for 312 yards at 7.1 a carry last week; Troy's offense ranks 40th on the ground and 118th through the air, so it has to run to move the ball.
Win on the ground against a solid front. Troy allows 3.9 a carry; USA needs its backs above the 103 combined yards they had at Louisiana.
Cash in Troy's mistakes. Troy has 15 giveaways and lost five last week; USA's turnover margin is +6.
Finish in the red zone. Troy's red-zone defense allows scores on 72.7% of trips (9th in FBS); field goals will not be enough against a defense that good inside the 20.
opp: Protect the ball. Troy lost five turnovers against Louisiana Tech and is +1 for the season.
Stay ahead of the chains. Troy converts 31.3% on third down and went 3 of 15 last week, but USA's defense allows 42.3%.

players.name: Bishop Davenport
players.note: Started at Louisiana: 16 of 22 for 210 yards and an INT, plus 11 carries for 57 yards and 2 TD. Jared Hollins (82 of 156, 1,195 yards, 9 TD, 4 INT) is still the season passing leader; no source found names this week's starter.

players.name: Brendan Jenkins
players.note: Team leader with 33 catches for 552 yards and 3 TD. Had 6 catches for 101 yards at Louisiana.

players.name: Donnie Smith
players.note: Troy's sacks leader with 8. USA has allowed 13 sacks all season.

players.name: Gavin Griffin
players.note: 108 carries, 465 yards, 4 TD. Had 10 carries for 29 yards and a TD against Louisiana Tech; Jaheim Merriweather ran for 84 and a TD in the Oct. 29 win at JMU.

watch.title: Troy's quarterback
watch.text: Goose Crowder is Troy's passing leader (1,162 yards, 9 TD, 5 INT) but went 6 of 14 against UL Monroe on Oct. 24, and Tucker Kilcrease started the last two games (15 of 31 at JMU, 18 of 33 for 215 against Louisiana Tech). No source found explains why.

watch.title: Kickoff coverage
watch.text: Louisiana's JJ Garner returned the opening kickoff 100 yards for a TD last week in a two-point USA loss. Troy's Justin Powe had three interceptions and a pick-six at JMU, so Troy's defense and specials can score.

watch.title: The Belt stays home or leaves
watch.text: Troy won 31-24 in overtime in Troy last season; USA won 25-9 in Mobile in 2024. The loser falls to 2-4 in the Sun Belt.

injuries: No injury report found for either team as of Nov. 12 (checked ESPN game page and preview, troytrojans.com, Troy and USA game recaps).
Troy QB Goose Crowder has not started since Oct. 24; whether he is injured was not found in any source.
USA has not said whether Bishop Davenport or Jared Hollins starts; no reason for the Louisiana switch was found.
preview.weather: ESPN/AccuWeather forecast for the 6 p.m. kickoff (checked Nov. 12): 51°F, mostly clear, 0% chance of rain, gusts to 12 mph. Natural grass.

lastGame.usa: Lost 28-26 at Louisiana on Nov. 7 (allowed 312 rushing yards and a 100-yard kickoff return TD, 4 of 12 on third down, final drive ended in an INT).
lastGame.opp: Lost 41-17 at home to Louisiana Tech on Nov. 7 (5 turnovers, 47 rushing yards on 32 carries, 3 of 15 on third down).

prediction.reasoning: USA scores 10 more points a game, is at home, and has the better turnover and penalty numbers against a Troy offense that has topped 24 points once since Sept. 12. Troy's run defense and red-zone defense keep it close, and USA's defense has allowed 28 or more in seven of nine games.
prediction.risks: If Troy runs the ball the way Louisiana did, USA's 105th-ranked run defense loses the game for it. Troy's defense has scored (pick-six at JMU), and both teams' quarterback situations are unsettled; a healthy Crowder would change Troy's passing game.

preview.context: Battle for the Belt, 15th meeting. Troy leads the series 10-4 and has won three of the last four: 10-6 (2022), 28-10 (2023), USA 25-9 in Mobile (2024), and Troy 31-24 in overtime in Troy (Oct. 4, 2025). Troy is 3-2 at home and 1-3 on the road this year: a win at JMU and losses at Missouri, Utah State and Louisiana. Kickoff 6 p.m. Central on ESPN+ and the Jags Radio Network.

notes: Injuries: still no injury report found for either team (ESPN game page lists none, checked 12:40 a.m. game day). A BVM Sports preview says Bishop Davenport returned last week after missing six games with an injury; neither school has named a starting quarterback.
Weather is unchanged from the preview. ESPN/AccuWeather shows 51°F at kickoff, 0% chance of rain and gusts to 12 mph. Natural grass at Hancock Whitney Stadium.
Kickoff is still 6 p.m. Central on ESPN+ and the Jaguars Radio Network. Both teams remain 4-5 (2-3 Sun Belt) per ESPN, and no other news changed since the preview, so the pick stays USA 27, Troy 20.
